news_summary: Silver has fallen more than 53% from its January 2026 record, from a peak near $117-$121 an ounce to around $54 by October 23, while gold has dropped 26% from its all-time January peak.
payoff: The reversal was driven by rate-hike expectations, higher energy prices and margin-driven selling.
